title: Targeted delivery of gemcitabine to lung cancer cells via a hyaluronic acid-based nanoplatform
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25944-25963
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02076C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fengbo Yu, Jingdan Cao, Xingjun Fan, Junxia Gao, Guifang Liu, Chonghuan Lin, Ying Zhu, Qiang Wang
A CD44-targeted nanoplatform (GEM@HA-(HAP/PSI)) with a high drug-loading HAP core and HA–PSI shell enables active targeting, pH-responsive release, CD44-mediated endocytosis, superior in vitro antitumor activity and in vivo tumor suppression.
